answers.how: Initial ball centers are about 132 pixels apart. Using a measured ball diameter of 53 pixels, the distance is 132 × 5.72/53 cm.
The white ball moves approximately 243 pixels between 1.00 s and 2.00 s. Converting with 5.72 cm per 53 pixels gives an average velocity magnitude of 26.2 cm/s.
Nearby frames give an orange-ball speed of approximately 225 pixels/s at 1.00 s. Multiplying by 5.72/53 converts this to cm/s.
The final purple and black ball centers are approximately 162 pixels apart. Their distance is 162 × 5.72/53 cm.
A smoothed fit to the left yellow ball's positions around 2.00 s gives an acceleration magnitude of approximately 43 pixels/s². Multiplying by 5.72/53 converts this to cm/s².
